```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Importing Breeding Sites Data
```{r}
bird_breeding_sites <- read.csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(bird_breeding_sites)
```
## Importing Connectivity Data
```{r}
migratory_connectivity <- read.csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migratory_connectivity))
```
## Glimpse Function
```{r}
glimpse(migratory_connectivity)
```
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(breeding_longitude = Longitude, breeding_latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```
## Selecting DF Columnn
```{r}
bird_migration_selected <- migratory_connectivity |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(winter_longitude = winterLongitude, winter_latitude = winterLatitude, stopover_longitude = pslon, stopover_latitude = pslat, iberian_longitude = iblon, iberian_latitude = iblat, westmost_longitude = awestlon, westmost_latitude = awestlat)
# gt(head(bird_migration_selected))
```
## Filtering DF
```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
```
## Group Medians of DF
```{r}
bird_migration_group_meds <- bird_migration_exc |>
  group_by(Site) |>
  summarise(
    stopover_latitude = median(stopover_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    stopover_longitude = median(stopover_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    iberian_latitude = median(iberian_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    iberian_longitude = median(iberian_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    westmost_latitude = median(westmost_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    westmost_longitude = median(westmost_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    winter_latitude = median(winter_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    winter_longitude = median(winter_longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
gt(bird_migration_group_meds)
```
## Joining DFs
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_group_meds)
gt(combined_bird_data)
```
## Pivoted DF
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_longitude", "_latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("location_type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```
## Spring and Autumn Subsets
```{r}
spring_locations <- c("breeding", "stopover", "winter")
autumn_locations <- c("breeding", "iberian", "westmost", "winter")
spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(location_type %in% spring_locations)
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(location_type %in% autumn_locations)

write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```

## Creating a Plot for Spring (Like Plot 1B)
```{r}
min_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(longitude) |>
  min()
max_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(longitude) |>
  max()
min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(latitude) |>
  min()
max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(latitude) |>
  max()


ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, colour = Site, shape = location_type)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2), ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_classic()
```
## Creating a Plot for Autumn (Like Plot 1|A)
```{r}
min_lon_autumn <- autumn_data |>
  pull(longitude) |>
  min()
max_lon_autumn <- autumn_data |>
  pull(longitude) |>
  max()
min_lat_autumn <- autumn_data |>
  pull(latitude) |>
  min()
max_lat_autumn <- autumn_data |>
  pull(latitude) |>
  max()


ggplot(
  autumn_data,
  aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, colour = Site, shape = location_type)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_lon_autumn - 2, max_lon_autumn + 2), ylim = c(min_lat_autumn - 2, max_lat_autumn + 2)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Autumn Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_classic()
```
